## History

Emily is a classmate of [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) who attends Regent's [Academy](../codex/places.md#regent-s-academy). Along with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and their other classmates, she adjusts to life at the academy as their examinations approach, balancing their friendships against their academic rivalry.
